# JevStyle

> Open-source local classification, routing, and scoring for AI agents, using small decision models that return probabilities for predefined options.

Maintainer: Chaoliang Yan. Code and weights: Apache-2.0.
Hosted API: operational, 2B v4 Q4_K_M, text only, one request at a time. Reviewed 2026-10-29. Local models and hosted demos are separate.
Current Python package: 0.6.2. Local default: 0.8B v3; --release 2b selects 2B v4 (released 2026-10-27).
2B v4: text and images with PyTorch; MLX and GGUF builds are text-only.
Jev-Style 2B v4 was trained in part on soft labels distilled from TypeSafe Jev 1.14 through its public API. This does not imply affiliation or endorsement.

## Reading the evidence

Published benchmark results are project self-runs, not official leaderboard positions. See the benchmark page for protocol and limitations. Weight sizes are not total runtime memory. Select thresholds on held-out examples from the intended task.
